newsitem.title: UK: John David Sports issues pathfinder prospectus.
newsitem.headline: John David Sports issues pathfinder prospectus.

text.p: John David Sports Plc, a sports and leisurewear retailer, issued the pathfinder prospectus for its proposed flotation on the London Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
A placing of new and existing ordinary shares by sponsor BZW will raise approximately 8.9 million stg, which will partly be used to finance expansion, the company said.
Final listing particulars and full placing details will be announced in October.
"We are delighted that, after fifteen years of trading, the company has reached this exciting point in its history," said executive chairman John Wardle.
He said the firm believed there were significant growth opportunities in the branded sports and leisure wear market.
